{{Quote|What is the meaning of this?|The Neimoidian envoy, seeing Chi Eekway Papanoida being freed by Ahsoka Tano and Riyo Chuchi along with sliced-up [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]|<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>}}
A '''Neimoidian envoy''' was involved in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockade of Pantora]]. He was stationed on board a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] along with [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay]]. He was in the hangar when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived. He went to the prison with [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] soldiers to stop [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] after they freed [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]], daughter of [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]].

He denied having any involvement in the [[Kidnapping of the Papanoida daughters/Legends|abduction]] of the Chairman's daughter but finally agreed to free her in order to prevent a possible scandal for the Trade Federation caused by [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay]] and reluctantly agreed to start negotiations in ending the Blockade of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The envoy was voiced by [[Tom Kenny]] who also voiced [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] in the episode. In the new Sphere of Influence Guide, he is called [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]]. Lott Dod is a separate [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Senator.
